places-drobeta-turnu-severin-podul-lui-t.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the catalogued places the recipe names — a corridor between them, not a routed line. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.
places-drobeta-turnu-severin-podul-lui-t.story: From Drobeta-Turnu Severin it runs 394 km to Drobeta-Turnu Severin; allow about 6 h 48 of riding. The stops in between: Domogled - Valea Cernei - Domogled-Coronin, Teregova - La Hideg, Iaz Tibiscum Dâmb and Berzovia - Berzobis. The highest point is about 900 m. It crosses from Serbia into Romania - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
